info.title: PostureRMM Integration API
info.description:
Access to a PostureRMM install, for scripts and integrations: reads, and the writes that pass the same server-side gates as the web UI.

Within v1 a release may only add: an operation, an optional input, a response field or an enum value. Clients ignore fields they do not know and treat an enum value they do not know as unknown. Lists answer in a `{data, pagination}` envelope; `page` is 1-indexed and `per_page` is clamped to 1-100. Every error is `{error, message, details?}`.

Super admin only: the pull writes every shared feed table, for every
Organization (ADR-0072). It answers 202 with no body, and the sync runs

minutes, which is why the request does not wait. Answers 503 when the server's
feed puller is not running.

post.summary: Export the Organization's evidence pack as a file.
post.description:
Admin only. The same pack, signing and audit as
`GET /api/v1/tenants/{id}/evidence-pack`, for the key's own Organization and
as a POST. The default is the signed JSON pack: its keys are sorted at every
level, and `signature` is an HMAC-SHA256 over the pack without it, keyed per
Organization. `format=pdf` answers the report instead, unsigned, and `503`
on a server built without PDF export. The pack holds the Posture Score as of
the request (the three pillars, Prevention counting only the PostureRMM
Recommended profile; ADR-0027, ADR-0034), computed over the whole
Organization whatever the key's group scope; the stored 90-day score series;
the points ledger with its hashes; the open and risk-accepted actions; the
whole-Organization maintenance windows; and agent health. A risk-accepted
finding scores as a pass in the score and is listed as an exception beside
it. Each export is audited.

post.summary: Reveal a stored credential's secret.
post.description:
Admin or super admin, and only for the credential's owner: a credential
belongs to the user who created it, so another admin, even a super admin,
answers 404.

**This is a reveal.** It needs a step-up: a `reason` and the caller's
`password`, or a `code` for an account with TOTP enrolled. Every reveal is
audited (`stored_credential_reveal`, with the reason, never the secret)
before the plaintext is returned, and if that audit row cannot be written the
reveal fails and nothing is returned. A wrong password or code is audited
(`stored_credential_reveal_failure`) and counts toward the account's lockout:
once it trips, the reveal answers 423 until the lockout ends. A wrong guess
answers 401; a missing, overlong or password-repeating `reason` answers 400
and costs no guess.

A password credential answers `password`; a private-key credential answers
`secret_kind: "private_key"` and `secret`, with no `password`.

ComplianceSummaryResponse.description:
Compliance summary response.

**Contract change, 2026-07-25 (#2591).** `total_checks`, `not_applicable`,
`skipped` and the matching `by_status` entries narrowed to *checks that could
apply to this endpoint*: a check written for an operating system this host can
never be no longer appears in any of them. On a Windows 10 endpoint that took
`total_checks` from 2311 to ~679 and `not_applicable` from ~1942 to
approximately zero — the field now means "genuine per-endpoint exception" (a
release-gated check, an absent app) rather than "the rest of the catalogue".
`passed`, `failed`, `errors`, `critical_failures`, `high_failures` and
`compliance_percent` are unchanged for every endpoint; the percentage is
`passed / (passed + failed)` and already excluded `not_applicable`. There were
no external consumers pre-launch, so no compatibility shim exists. Rationale
and the paired `compliance_snapshots` step change: ADR-0027 →
"Per-endpoint compliance summary — applicability".

owner_user_id.description: The user who owns the action. `null` removes the owner.

risk_accept_expires.description: The day an accepted risk lapses. `null` accepts it indefinitely.

risk_accept_reason.description: Why the risk is accepted. It is audited with the acceptance.

PatchSummaryResponse.description: Counts of an endpoint's Windows updates by state.

critical.description: Severity breakdown of the missing and approved updates.

last_scan_at.description: The most recent scan across the endpoint's update rows.

not_applicable.description:
Updates an authoritative scan stopped reporting missing without
reporting them installed.

PeerBaselineResponse.description:
Percentile scores for a category and industry cohort, delivered by the feed.
They are not computed from this install's fleet.

as_of.description: The day the percentiles were computed.

PhysicalDisk.description: One physical disk and its SMART state.

device_id.description: Unique per host on Windows. Absent on Linux and from older agents.

nvme_percentage_used.description: NVMe percentage of rated life consumed, 0-100. Absent for other disks.

read_errors_uncorrected.description: Absent when the disk does not report it.

temperature_celsius.description: Degrees Celsius. Absent when the disk does not report it.

write_errors_uncorrected.description: Absent when the disk does not report it.

coverage_pct.description: Share of the pillar's rules that were measured, 0.0 to 1.0.

score_pct.description:
0.0 to 1.0. Null when the pillar measured nothing (`coverage_pct` is 0):
that is "not yet measured", never a score of zero.

PillarWeightsResponse.description:
The weight each pillar carries in the composite. Equal by default; an
Organization can change them in its scoring settings (ADR-0027). A pillar
that has measured nothing carries none, whatever its weight.

PinResponse.description: A profile version the Organization pinned.

pinned_by.description: The user who pinned it; null once that user is gone.

PostureActionResponse.description:
One recommended action: a fix that raises the Posture Score, and where it
stands in the risk register.

action_key.description:
Stable key of the finding, for example `compliance:<check id>` or
`patch:CVE-2026-0001`.

affected_count.description: Endpoints the finding is open on.

auto_action_type.description:
`deploy` (install an app from the catalogue) or `script`. Null when the
action has no automatic fix.

auto_fixable.description: The action carries an automatic fix: `do` can run it.

auto_source_id.description: The catalogue entry or script the fix runs.

category.description:
`patching`, `vulnerabilities`, `compliance`, `hardening`, `operations` or
`deploy_software`. Treat an unknown value as unknown.

freeze_hold.description:
A patch freeze window that covers the whole Organization is in effect now,
and the action is a patching, vulnerabilities or hardening one.

gain_points.description:
Points of the Posture Score (on the dashboard's 0 to 100) that completing
the action recovers. Frozen while the risk is accepted.

risk_accept_expires.description:
The day an accepted risk lapses and the points come back. Null for an
indefinite acceptance, and for an action whose risk is not accepted.

PostureActionsResponse.description: The recommended actions that match the filter, open ones first.

actions.description: Open first, then by points recovered, largest first.

total_gain_open.description: The points all open actions would recover, whatever the filter.

total_open.description: Every open action in the Organization, whatever the filter.

PostureBaselineResponse.description: The scored baseline Prevention was computed under (ADR-0112).

coverage_pct.description: How much of what applies to the fleet the pillar measured, 0 to 1.

critical_fail_triggered.description:
A rule flagged critical-fail has a confirmed failure. A flag, not a cap:
it does not move the score.

score_pct.description: The pillar's score over what it measured, 0 to 1.

PostureExplodeResponse.description:
The Posture Score with every rule under it: the same composite as
`posture-score`, one level deeper.

PostureParameter.description: A threshold of a Performance rule, and where this Organization has set it.

default_value.description: What the rule uses until the Organization overrides it.

effective_value.description:
`override_value`, or `default_value` when there is none: what the rule
uses.

group_name.description: Display heading of the rule file this rule belongs to.

override_value.description: The Organization's own value. Null while it follows the default.

PostureParametersResponse.description: Every threshold the Organization can tune.

PostureScoreResponse.description:
The fleet's Posture Score: the composite of the three pillars, Prevention,
Patching and Performance (ADR-0027), with its movement.

grade.description: A letter band of the composite.

measured.description:
False while a pillar has measured nothing. `score`, `score_pct` and `grade`
are then a mean over the pillars that did, and a client must not present
them as the fleet's number (ADR-0027).

ruleset_version.description:
The ruleset the rules were evaluated under. A change of ruleset moves the
score without the fleet having changed.

score.description: The composite on the legacy 0 to 1000 scale.

score_pct.description: The composite, 0 to 1. Prefer it to `score`.

today_delta.description:
`score` minus the stored snapshot's score of the day before, for the
same groups: a key limited to some groups is compared with the snapshot
stored for those groups (ADR-0173). Null when that day has no measured
snapshot, as for groups not yet snapshotted then, and when the
Prevention baseline changed since (ADR-0112).

unavailable_pts.description: `round((1 - coverage_pct) x 1000)`: the points nothing has measured yet.

PostureTargetResponse.description: The Posture Score the Organization aims for.

set_by.description: The user who set it. Null when unset, or once that user is gone.

target.description: On the 0 to 1000 scale of `score`. 850 until someone sets one.

PostureTrendPointResponse.description: One day of the fleet posture series.

PostureTrendResponse.description: The fleet composite over a window, one point per snapshot day.

points.description:
Oldest first. A day on which a pillar measured nothing has no point. A
key limited to some groups gets the series stored for those groups
(ADR-0173), which starts the day they were first snapshotted.

window.description: The window that was applied: `7d`, `14d`, `30d`, `90d` or `1y`.

disk_read_bytes_per_sec.description: Bytes read from disk since the last sample (a delta, not a total).

disk_written_bytes_per_sec.description: Bytes written to disk since the last sample (a delta, not a total).

start_time_unix.description: Start time as Unix epoch seconds.

ProfileSummaryResponse.description: A compliance profile and how the fleet stands against it.

applicable_hosts.description:
Endpoints this profile's platform can apply to. Null means the platform
applicability registry has not reached this install: it is not zero.

compliance_percent.description: 0 to 100, one decimal, over pass and fail (errors excluded).

id.description: Database id of the profile row.

last_assessed.description: The newest result for this profile in the key's scope.

pinned_version.description: Version the Organization pinned, null when it follows the latest.

PropertyValueResponse.description: The value of one custom property on one endpoint.

property_type.description:
How the agent collects it: `file_version`, `file_exists`, `file_hash`,
`registry_value`, `registry_exists`, `environment_variable` or
`wmi_query`. Treat a value you do not know as unknown.

value.description: Null until collected, or when collection failed.

total.description:
Every relay the install knows. Relays belong to the install, not to an
Organization or a group.

PutBody.description: The Posture Score to aim for.

target.description:
On the 0 to 1000 scale of the Posture Score's `score`. Anything outside
that answers `400`.

PutParameter.description: One threshold to set or clear.

override_value.description:
The value to write. `null` clears the override, so the rule follows its
default again. A value outside the parameter's `min` and `max` answers
`400`.

RawTelemetryResponse.description: The most recent check-in the endpoint's agent sent, credentials removed.

payload.description:
The check-in as the agent sent it. Free-form: its keys follow the agent's
version and are not part of the v1 promise. Null when `received_at` is.

received_at.description: Null when the agent has not checked in.

ReachabilitySample.description: One 30-minute bucket of the 24-hour reachability series.

ratio.description: Fraction of samples that were reachable, 0.0 to 1.0.

rtt.description: Average heartbeat round trip in ms; null when the bucket measured none.

RebootIndicatorsResponse.description:
Which pending-reboot indicators the agent observed. A `false` means not
observed; `unreadable` names the indicators the agent could not read.

ReconciliationLogEntry.description: What one feed sync retired from the catalogue.

apps_removed.description: Apps the feed dropped from the catalogue.

bundle_version.description: The feed bundle version the sync applied. Null when it carried none.

packages_superseded.description: Patch packages replaced by a newer one.

ReinstateResponse.description: The outcome of reinstating a decommissioned endpoint.

status.description:
Always `pending`: the endpoint is `online` again once its agent next
checks in.

oneOf.description:
One deployment fanned out across `dispatched` targets (`queued` of which
were offline and apply at next check-in).

Dangerous remediation withheld pending `confirm_dangerous=true`. Nothing
was dispatched; send the request again with the flag to apply it.

RemediateActionResponse.description:
Outcome of a per-row bulk remediate dispatch (ADR-0056 Decision 3).

Mirrors the single-result `RemediateResultResponse` shape so API clients
handle both surfaces uniformly, but carries the device-count blast radius
the bulk confirm needs.

oneOf.description: A deployment+task was created.

Dangerous remediation withheld pending `confirm_dangerous=true`. Nothing
was dispatched; send the request again with the flag to apply it.

RemediateResultResponse.description:
Outcome of a remediate dispatch request (ADR-0056 Decision 3).

`Dispatched` is the existing behaviour; `ConfirmationRequired` is the
server-authoritative guard rail — a structured response (not a dispatch)
the UI renders as the two-step confirm. A fix the gate refuses yields
neither: it answers 422 (see `remediation_gate`).

closed.description: Live sessions closed, socket and record both.

failed.description:
Sessions whose socket was closed but whose record failed to write. Never
"sessions still running".

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Request body for admin password reset.

password.description: The new password, a secret. The user must change it at the next sign-in.

ok.description: Always `true`: a failure answers an error body.

RiskAcceptanceResponse.description:
Why a rule's risk is accepted. An accepted rule scores as a pass for as long
as the acceptance lasts (ADR-0027).

expires.description: The day the acceptance lapses. Null is an indefinite acceptance.

RoleWire.description: What a user or an API key may do. Treat an unknown value as unknown.

RuleEndpointsResponse.description: How the endpoints stand against one rule.

rule_id.description: For a Prevention rule, the check's PRC id. Otherwise the dotted id asked for.

rule_name.description: Null when the rule is unknown.

ScanResponse.description:
What a vulnerability scan of one endpoint did. A count of work done, not a
list of findings: read those from the vulnerabilities routes.

cpe_unmatched.description:
Entries with no CPE match. They have no vulnerability lane at all, so this
is the endpoint's coverage gap.

vulns_auto_resolved.description: Open vulnerabilities this scan found fixed and closed.

SchedulerHealthResponse.description: What the install's scheduler has been doing.

SchedulerStateWire.description:
What the scheduler's task table says taken as a whole. Treat an unknown value
as unknown.

SchedulerTaskResponse.description: The last run of one scheduled task.

stale.description: The task has not run for longer than it should.

SecretKindWire.description:
What a stored credential's secret is. A request names it, a response reports
it, so this mirror reads as well as writes. Treat an unknown value as unknown.

ServiceActionResponse.description: The agent's answer to a service control or configuration request.

message.description:
Set by a Windows agent that had nothing to do, for example
`already running`.

status.description: `success`. A failure answers `422` with the agent's message instead.

is_microsoft.description:
A vendor-owned service (signed by Microsoft on Windows, a distribution
unit on Linux). Stopping or disabling one needs `confirmation_name`.

name.description: The name to put in the control routes' `{name}`.

oneOf.description: What the service does when it fails. Null where the platform has none.

signer.description: The executable's signer, when its signature is valid.

start_type.description:
`auto`, `auto_delayed`, `manual` or `disabled`. Treat any other value as
unknown.

status.description:
`running`, `stopped`, `paused`, `start_pending`, `stop_pending`,
`continue_pending` or `pause_pending`. Treat any other value as unknown.

ServiceListResponse.description: Services (Windows) or systemd units (Linux) on the endpoint.

ServiceWriteRequest.description: An `is_microsoft` a client still sends is ignored (#5198).

confirmation_name.description:
The service's name, typed back. Required to stop or restart a
vendor-owned service (`is_microsoft` in the service list); the agent's
list, not the request, says which services those are.

SetPasswordRequest.description: The account and its new password.

password.description:
The new password, a secret. The agent checks its strength, and a weak one
fails the task.

password_must_change.description: The user must choose a new password at the next sign-in.

severity.description: `unscored` is its own bucket; `none` counts a real CVSS 0.0 only (#5303).

SkipReasonWire.description: Why a dispatch left an endpoint out. Treat an unknown value as unknown.

SkippedEndpointResponse.description:
An endpoint a dispatch did not create work for, or one endpoint and item pair
it accounts for anyway.

detail.description: Human-readable text. It may change between releases.

oneOf.description: Set when the skip is one endpoint and item pair rather than the endpoint.

SkippedItemKindWire.description: The kind of cart item a skip is about. Treat an unknown value as unknown.

SkippedItemResponse.description: The cart item a skip is about.

SkippedPackageResponse.description: A Linux endpoint and package pair a dispatch left out.

detail.description: Human-readable text. It may change between releases.

SkippedUpdateResponse.description: A Windows Update left out because no curated offline package exists for it.

SmartStatusWire.description:
Whether the disk's SMART reliability counter could be read. Treat an
unknown value as unknown.

StalledPackage.description: A winget package whose upstream manifest fetch has given up.

fetch_failure_count.description: Failed fetches so far. Always at or past the give-up threshold.

last_fetch_failure_at.description: Null when no failure time is recorded.

source.description: Where the row came from. Never `custom`: tenant-private uploads are not listed.

version.description: Null when the row carries no version.

StartupItem.description:
One startup item. The write routes take `name`, `item_type` and `source_path`
back as `item_name`, `item_type` and `source_path`.

is_microsoft.description: Signed by Microsoft on Windows, a distribution unit on Linux.

item_type.description:
Where it is registered: `run_key_hklm`, `run_key_hkcu`, `run_once_key_hklm`,
`run_once_key_hkcu`, `startup_folder_allusers`, `startup_folder_user`,
`scheduled_task`, `systemd_unit`, `cron_reboot` or `rc_local`. Treat any
other value as unknown.

signer.description: The executable's signer, when its signature is valid.

source_path.description: The registry key, folder, task path or file it is registered in.

user.description: The user whose profile holds it. Null for an all-users item.

StartupItemsResponse.description:
What starts with the endpoint.

A Linux agent that cannot list its units answers `200` with `{"error": "..."}`
and no `items`.

SuccessResponse.description: The body of an action with nothing to return but its outcome.

success.description: Always `true`: a failure answers an error body.

TagResponse.description: A tag assigned to an endpoint.

TaskQueuedResponse.description:
What an action that queues work for an endpoint's agent answers.

The work has not run yet. Read its outcome from
`GET /api/v1/endpoints/{id}/tasks/{task_id}` (`get_endpoint_task`): the
task's `status` leaves `pending` when the agent reports back, and `result`
or `error_message` then carries what happened.

TaskResponse.description: One task queued for, or run by, an endpoint.

deployment_id.description: Set when the task is a step of a deployment.

payload.description:
What the task was asked to do, with secrets removed. Free-form: its keys
depend on `task_type` and are not part of the v1 promise.

result.description: What the agent reported back. Free-form, like `payload`.

tenant_id.description: The Organization that owns the task.

verifies_task_id.description: Set when the task exists to re-measure another task's effect.

TaskStatusWire.description: Where a task stands. Treat an unknown value as unknown.

TaskTypeWire.description: What a task does. Treat an unknown value as unknown.

company_name.description:
The name its surfaces show: the Organization's own, else the
installation's, else `PostureRMM`.

has_logo.description: A logo shows: the Organization's own, else the installation's.

logo_version.description: Changes whenever the logo does. Null when there is none.

TenantListItem.description: An Organization in the list, with its endpoint count.

is_active.description: `false` once the Organization is deactivated: nobody in it can sign in.

parent_tenant_id.description: The MSP that manages this Organization. Null when none does.

settings.description: Free-form Organization settings. Only `branding.company_name` is promised.

TenantTypeWire.description: How an Organization relates to the others. Treat an unknown value as unknown.

TrustProvenanceWire.description: How the agent established trust in the server certificate.

UndeliverableWire.description:
Why a Linux package fix cannot be deployed to an endpoint. Treat an unknown
value as unknown.

UpdateAppCatalogRequest.description:
A change to a catalog entry. A field left out stays as it is. The nullable
ones also take an explicit `null`, which clears them.

UpdateComplianceResultRequest.description: A remediation status to record by hand.

remediation_message.description: A note stored with the status. Ignored without `remediation_status`.

oneOf.description: Where the remediation stands. Without it nothing changes.

UpdateCredentialRequest.description: A change to a credential. The name and username are always replaced.

domain.description: The Windows logon domain. Omitting it clears it.

password.description:
A new secret. Omit it to keep the stored one. Also accepted under the
name `secret`.

oneOf.description: What the new secret is. Defaults to `password`, and needs a new secret.

UpdateEndpointRequest.description: A change to an endpoint. A field left out stays as it is.

group_id.description:
The group to move the endpoint into. An explicit `null` removes it from
its group.

oneOf.description: The metadata the endpoint ends up with.

tag_ids.description: The tags the endpoint ends up with. They replace its current tags.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: A field left out stays as it is.

UpdateTenantRequest.description: A field left out stays as it is.

is_active.description:
`false` deactivates the Organization: every user's sessions and API keys are
revoked and its agents are disconnected.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Request body for updating a user. A field left out stays as it is.

is_active.description: `false` deactivates the user and revokes their sessions and API keys.

scope_group_ids.description: Group scope for group-scoped roles. Omit to leave unchanged.

UpgradeRequest.description: The agent release to move to.

target_version.description:
A version the install holds a release for, for example `1.15.0`. Any
other value answers `400`.

UpgradeResponse.description: An upgrade queued, with the deployment that tracks it.

deployment_id.description: The deployment that records the upgrade.

UpsertPinBody.description: The version to pin a profile to.

pinned_version.description: The profile version to follow. Must not be empty.

reason.description: Why. Kept with the pin and in the audit log.

UserDetailResponse.description: One user, with the fields only an administrator sees.

is_bootstrap.description: The install's first administrator: its role cannot change and it cannot be deleted.

locked_until.description: Null when the account is not locked.

must_change_password.description: The user must choose a new password at the next sign-in.

oneOf.description:
Present **only** on a `PATCH` that deactivated this user: what happened
to their live remote sessions (#2326).

It is a *report*, not a status: deactivation is durable before this runs,
so a non-zero `failed` still comes back on a 200. The caller is being
told that the account is off but that a socket teardown did not record
cleanly — go read the audit log — and is emphatically **not** being
invited to retry the deactivation.

scope_group_ids.description: The groups a group-scoped role reads. Absent for a role that reads everything.

is_bootstrap.description: The install's first administrator: its role cannot change and it cannot be deleted.

scope_group_ids.description: The groups a group-scoped role reads. Absent for a role that reads everything.

UserProfileResponse.description: The signed-in user, in the Organization the request acts in.

role.description: The role in the acting Organization.

scope_group_ids.description: The groups a group-scoped role reads. Absent for a role that reads everything.

tenant_name.description: The acting Organization's name. Absent on the answer to `PATCH`.

oneOf.description: Absent on the answer to `PATCH`.

totp_enabled.description: Whether the user has two-factor sign-in enrolled.

VulnerabilitySeverityWire.description:
A vulnerability's severity bucket. `none` is a real CVSS 0.0; `unscored` is a
CVE the NVD has not scored yet.

VulnerabilityStatusWire.description: Lifecycle of one vulnerability on one endpoint.

oneOf.description: Now.
At a wall-clock time in a time zone.

timezone.description:
An IANA name such as `Europe/London`, or `endpoint_local` for each
endpoint's own reported zone (UTC where it reports none).

oneOf.description: When each endpoint next enters its maintenance window.

WindowsUpdateResponse.description: One Windows update and where it stands on one endpoint.

pending_work.description:
Whether the update belongs in the endpoint's pending queue: not
superseded here and not a SQL Server cumulative-update alternative.

scan_catalog_version.description: The `wsusscn2.cab` version an offline scan ran against.

scan_source.description:
How the row was discovered: null for an online scan, `offline_cab` for a
scan against a `wsusscn2.cab`.

status.description: The update's state on this endpoint. Treat a value you do not know as unknown.

WsTransportWire.description: The agent's own report of its WebSocket state.

bearer.description: An API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer frt_...`. The key's role ceiling and group scope bound every call. A key minted in a client Organization acts there; otherwise `X-Tenant-Id` selects among the Organizations the key may act in.
